newsitem.title: UK: Commercial Union buys 51 pct in Marlborough.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Union buys 51 pct in Marlborough.

text.p: British insurance group Commercial Union said on Tuesday that it had signed an agreement to acquire 51 percent in Marlborough Underwriting Agency Ltd from Blenheim Partnership.
The acquisition will make Commerical Union the first major UK composite insurer to take an active participation in Lloyds.
MUAL is a Lloyds managing agent which manages Syndicates 62 and 744 -- both writing marine busiess -- and 1047, a non-marine syndicate.
The remaining 49 percent would continue to be held by Blenheim Partnership which consists mainly the executive directors and underwriters of MUAL.
Commercial Union said it would have an option to acquire the balance of MUAL after five years.

"It is the intention of CU and MUAL to develop the business over the next few years from its current capacity of some 80 million stg so that MUAL becomes a major agency of Lloyds," Commercial Union said.
Lloyds welcomed Commercial Union's move with its chairman David Rowland saying, "it represents a siginificant vote of confidence in the future of Lloyd's and in the wider London market".
